fired.warning: at the **25 February 2027 FY2026 results**, re-read immediately if core cash is below **€562.0m** (15% below FY2025's €661.2m), or if net debt/EBITDA exceeds **2.0×**, the upper end of the revised issuer leverage range. Also warn at the **21 October 2026 Q3 update** if management cuts its FY organic-growth or margin outlook specifically because acquisitions or the Government Services exit require further spending; the absence of a quarterly cash statement does not count as a pass. A warning triggers review, not a sale.
fired.break: at the **25 February 2027 accounts**, the thesis fails if core cash is non-positive; or if cash after also deducting business acquisitions net of acquired cash, financial-asset purchases, loans advanced and acquisition-related debt/shareholder settlements is negative **and** net debt/EBITDA exceeds 2.0×. Include those settlements even when classified as financing, without double-counting them in acquisition cash. Test reported-profit recovery at the same filing: H2 2026 reported operating profit must exceed **€479.3m**, the issuer's H2 2025 comparator (€992.4m annual less €513.1m H1); a result at or below that amount breaks this recovery case even if adjusted EPS grows. A break calls for sale under §5.1, subject to Leo's execution. Retain each line's definition and reconcile any changed presentation. If the relevant disclosures disappear, record the test as unobservable and keep the position under warning; do not infer a pass or invent a zero. The cash test detects spending even when adjusted margin remains attractive, and the acquisition-inclusive test detects debt-funded expansion that a capex-only measure would miss.

fired.warning: (re-read, not a sale), first at the **21 October 2026** Q3 revenue release, then at any release before FY results: - management cuts its 2026 organic-growth guidance below "mid-to-high single-digit", or drops "strong cash flow generation"; **or** - it announces new exit, restructuring or disposal-loss provisions, or acquisitions whose stated price exceeds **€500m** in aggregate since 29 July (about half of FY2025 operating cash of €1,006.7m, from prices.json `capital`). The Q3 release is revenue-only, so silence on cash does not clear the warning.
fired.break: (sell under §5.1), checked at FY2026 results, by **1 March 2027**, if **any**: 1. FY2026 reported (IFRS) operating profit does not exceed FY2025's **€992.4m**. Management's own explanation of H1's fall was the prior-year Food Testing disposal gain; a full year with no such gain in the comparator should be higher if that explanation is true. 2. The gap between adjusted and reported operating profit is **more than 15% of adjusted operating profit** for the full year. In H1 it was €506.5m − €430.8m = €75.7m, **14.9%**. A full year above 15% means the "one-offs" are a recurring cost of the strategy. 3. Operating cash flow, less capex, lease payments, and acquisitions net of cash acquired, is zero or negative for FY2026.

fired.warning: the next FY/Q4 release reports another quarter of declining physical volume, full-year sales below the company's **$1,470m lower bound**, or free cash flow / company-adjusted net income **at or below 70%**, the boundary of management's greater-than-70% commitment. Inspect the issuer release by **10 November 2026**; local Yahoo estimates 5 November, which is not confirmed. Use OCF less all capex for FCF; list tariff refunds separately if quantified. A warning requires a reread, not a sale.
fired.break: by **28 February 2027**, sell under §5.1 if Q4 FY2026 and Q1 FY2027 both report declining physical volumes and GAAP operating margins below **18%**, or either quarter's GAAP operating margin falls below **16%**, or trailing reported operating profit / average opening and closing total assets falls below **11%**. Also break at the FY release by 10 November if full-year cash after all capex is non-positive. The return test must use issuer GAAP operating income, not the local field that adds back charges. If unit volumes are only described qualitatively, “lower” counts as declining; silence is missing evidence, not growth. These are tests for the **new two-share allocation** and do not silently replace the original eight shares' Review record. P3 can deteriorate while price increases and tariff recoveries support revenue or adjusted EPS: that is the mechanism of the dominant risk.

fired.warning: At **21 October 2026 Q3 results**, re-read if all-product revenue per contract (RPC) is more than 5% below Q3 2025's USD0.702, hence below **USD0.6669**, while average daily volume is flat or rising; also warn if interest-rate or equity-index RPC falls more than 5% against its own year-ago figure, even when mix masks the aggregate. Separately warn if GAAP operating margin falls below **64%**. Q2 RPC was USD0.678 against USD0.690 and GAAP margin was 64.89%; the RPC trigger is not already breached, but Q2 profit contraction deserves attention.
fired.break: Recommend exit under §5.1 if **two consecutive quarters** show RPC down more than 10% year on year at flat/rising volume **and** GAAP operating margin below 60%; alternatively if clearing and transaction revenue falls at rising volume for two consecutive quarters. Check Q3 on 21 October, then Q4/FY2026 by **28 February 2027** if no earlier results date is announced. Examine comparable product mix and segment RPC rather than explaining deterioration away as volume growth. These are analyst thresholds, not company guidance. Those observations would move when the dominant risk materialises: activity can rise while monetisation and operating returns deteriorate. A price decline alone is neither tier.

propose a sale under §5.1, at any review and at the latest by **31 May 2027** after FY27 results, if either: - **Lost revenue:** Experian discloses lost annualised revenue from report replacement, direct licensing or platform bypass of at least **5% of FY26 revenue ($422m)**, without a disclosed offsetting new recurring stream. - **Volume or price:** a comparable paid-volume or net-price series falls **more than 10%** year on year in two consecutive observations, attributed to such substitution. Separately, FY27 operating cash less intangibles, capex and lease principal at zero or below breaks the cash part of P2. It does not certify that the substitution risk has passed.

fired.warning: **Already active at entry.** H1 operating cash / attributable net profit is **0.573x**, below my **0.80x** threshold. At **12 November 2026**, re-read if the nine-month ratio remains below 0.80x or cash after equipment/intangible purchases and principal lease payments is non-positive. A reduction in the issuer's roughly €80m adjusted-EBIT outlook is an additional warning. The ratio is an analyst rule, not management guidance.
fired.break: At FY2026 results on **24 March 2027**, propose an exit under §5.1 if full-year operating cash / positive attributable net profit is below **0.80x**, or cash after the same reinvestment and lease payments is non-positive. Non-positive attributable profit is itself a break, not a way to pass the ratio. This allows a complete seasonal cycle, while the November warning forces an earlier review. Independently, at either the November or March result, a disclosed material impairment/default on related-party funding, or evidence that medical expansion requires recurring external funding despite growing reported profit, breaks the capital-allocation case immediately. Track Pentixapharm financing separately from operating capex: a financing outflow is not silently relabelled a recurring expense, and neither is it ignored. Use matching year-to-date periods from the consolidated statements, with parent-attributable profit. A missing component makes the test unresolved and triggers review, not a pass. These tests directly respond to P6: revenue and adjusted EBIT may rise while they fail. The thresholds are my investment rules. Definitions: [interim statements](https://www.ezag.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/euz226_d.pdf); dates: [issuer calendar](https://www.ezag.com/de/investoren/finanzkalender/).

At FY2026 results, checked by **1 March 2027**, sell under §5.1 if that full-year cash-after-reinvestment measure is **zero or negative**, or if full-year OCF/attributable profit is below **0.8x**. Independently, sell if filed trailing operating profit after all operating charges divided by average opening/closing total assets falls below **10%**. These analyst thresholds test cash absorption and capital productivity directly; no revenue miss is required. Use issuer statements and the same cash definitions, not the vendor's operating-income field.

fired.warning: At the September activity report, check by **8 October 2026**, re-read if fully electronic US high-grade TRACE share is below **18%**, versus 19.0% in August. At the **29 October** Q3 result, also warn if cash-credit variable fees per million decline by more than **15% year on year**, or credit revenue is flat/down despite rising credit ADV. These are my thresholds, not company guidance. They can detect lost share or poor monetisation while headline trading activity still rises.
fired.break: At Q3 and then Q4 results, reviewed no later than **28 February 2027**, either (a) fully electronic high-grade share below **17% in two successive monthly releases**, or (b) credit revenue declining year on year in **two successive quarters while credit ADV rises in each**, breaks the execution-economics thesis under §5.1. A separate route is two consecutive quarterly GAAP operating margins below **35%**: this catches deterioration outside credit. Do not require all three routes to fire. Use [Tradeweb monthly reports](https://www.tradeweb.com/newsroom/monthly-activity-reports/) for share and [quarterly results](https://investors.tradeweb.com/news/news-releases) for fees/revenue. Cross-check the market denominator against [FINRA TRACE monthly volume reports](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/browse-catalog/trace-volume-reports), published on the third business day after month-end, keeping the same bond/venue coverage. FINRA aggregate volume alone is not an independent Tradeweb share estimate. External competitor evidence already bites: MarketAxess reports Q2 credit fees per million **$129 versus $138**, and has suspended monthly volume releases following its announced ICE transaction ([competitor result](https://investor.marketaxess.com/news/news-details/2026/MarketAxess-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx)). Review its quarterly filings while available and ICE's transaction updates at each monthly checkpoint; no invented August comparator. Missing disclosure triggers a re-read, not a pass.

fired.warning: At FY2026 results, estimated locally for **5 November**, re-read by **10 November 2026** if physical volumes decline again, if free cash flow is **70% or less of company-adjusted net income**, or if trailing operating profit divided by average total assets falls below **13%**. Any one warns. The cash threshold is management's stated commitment; the asset-return threshold is my decision rule. Use the release's volume bridge when a percentage is not supplied; missing disclosure is unknown, not growth. [Q3 release](https://ir.muellerwaterproducts.com/press-releases/2026/08-05-2026-211118748).
fired.break: Sell the position under §5.1 if either of the first two post-entry quarters reports a GAAP operating margin below **16%**, or if **both** quarters have declining physical volumes and GAAP operating margins below **18%**. Independently, sell if trailing operating profit divided by average total assets falls below **11%** at either of those reports. Review the two-quarter test by **28 February 2027**. These thresholds are analyst choices: the separate margin and asset-return routes prevent rising prices from hiding falling capital productivity. For the asset test, use **filed TTM operating income after all operating charges / mean of total assets at the TTM beginning and end**. This is a pre-tax operating return on assets, not ROIC and not annualised single-quarter profit. Obtain the comparable filings at each review; if the beginning balance or a quarter is unavailable, report the test as unavailable and escalate the review rather than substituting local adjusted operating income. Today's nine-month filed operating income is $217.7m and June total assets $1,953.3m, but those are not a TTM ratio. [Q3 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1350593/000135059326000036/mwa-20260630.htm). These improve the proposed monitoring terms; the existing accepted proposal is not rewritten by an unaccepted top-up. If Leo accepts this proposal, use these tests for the resulting eight-share position.

fired.warning: At the FY2026 release, expected around 5 November (local date is an estimate), either another reported decline in consolidated physical volumes **or** FY free cash flow at or below 70% of management's adjusted net income triggers a re-read. The first tests whether price is masking demand; the second tests whether the profit is becoming cash. The 70% reference is management's cash-conversion commitment in its [Q3 release](https://ir.muellerwaterproducts.com/press-releases/2026/08-05-2026-211118748). If volumes are not quantified, use the explicit direction in the sales bridge; silence is unavailable evidence, not a pass.
fired.break: By the Q1 FY2027 release, reviewed no later than **28 February 2027**, two successive post-entry quarters with declining consolidated volumes **and** GAAP operating margin below **18% in each** break the capacity-return thesis and call for an exit under §5.1. This is my decision threshold, below the locally recorded FY2025 margin, not company guidance. Use filed operating income after reorganisation charges, not the local field if the discrepancy below persists. A missing disclosure triggers review, not an invented result.
